rules.SEL-v2: All2520 slots retained. For each declared condition evaluate each A/B config using all10 B2 records, complete validity/control qualification and its OWN target-load predicates. Select first eligible A elseB; no eligible =>NO_ELIGIBLE_CONDITION/BLOCKED. No candidate/M1R/M2 effect enters selection; no relabel, drop, clamp or expansion. All unselected/off-target records preserved.
rules.TIE-v2: A before B only; internal baseline service/node/resource ties unchanged. No effect-size ranking.
rules.FAIL-v2: invalid/failed/incomplete/provenance conflict =>preserve and halt entire plan; remaining NOT_STARTED. Natural infeasible, no-control-witness or valid-off-target are preserved scientific negatives; continue fixed slots, never select them. No automatic retry; exactly one registered replay after valid primary.

Controls use B2 only because feasibility witness/pressure focus, not comparative claims; absence of other methods in controls cannot prove their infeasibility. Candidates, A1/A2/A3, severe-overload and reserved partitions excluded by stage scope.
